revised_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: TripPet iOS mailbox page full-screen background, empty mailbox state
Primary request: vertical watercolor storybook illustration of a forest cabin front yard with a charming rural mailbox placed naturally near the small cottage entrance, no postcard visible and mailbox flag down/neutral.
Scene/backdrop: cozy wooden forest cabin set back in the midground, winding path, layered forest with clear foreground/midground/background depth, soft atmospheric perspective.
Subject: cream-colored rounded mailbox in the lower-middle/right foreground, attached to a wooden post beside the front path and cottage fence; mailbox is the clearest focal point.
Style/medium: warm hand-painted watercolor, delicate ink linework, matching a gentle mobile game art style.
Composition/framing: portrait 9:16 mobile background, leave the bottom 18% visually clean and low-detail for app navigation UI; keep important mailbox details above the bottom navigation zone; cabin behind mailbox but slightly softened; trees in far background softened with depth of field.
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon sunlight, cozy but not overly bright; cottage window light very subtle and weak.
Color palette: richer than pale pastel, warm greens, honey wood, cream mailbox, soft golden highlights.
Materials/textures: watercolor paper grain, hand-painted foliage, wooden fence and mailbox post, flowers and grass around mailbox kept restrained and not crowded.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no UI, no characters, no animals, no watermark, no red annotation boxes; bottom 18% clean; mailbox must not sit in the middle of the path, it belongs in front of the cottage near the fence/entrance.
Avoid: overgrown vegetation around mailbox, washed-out colors, central road-blocking mailbox placement, strong glowing cabin windows, flat background without depth.
